Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as solid jobs data fuels hawkish Fed bets
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower on Friday after a stronger-than-expected jobs report increased expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month. Investors are now awaiting upcoming inflation data to gauge the central bank's future policy path.

Markets.title: Strong jobs report fuels Fed rate hike prospects as Trump escalates rate cut pressure
Markets.summary: A strong U.S. jobs report has increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in September, despite pressure from Donald Trump to cut them. Markets are now waiting for U.S. inflation data to determine the Fed's next move.

Markets.title: Gland Pharma block deal: Fosun Pharma divests 99 lakh shares worth Rs 2,800 crore
Markets.summary: Fosun Pharma sold a 6% stake in Gland Pharma for ₹2,800 crore through a block deal, reducing its total holding to 45.77%. Major buyers of the shares included mutual funds managed by Kotak, Axis, and ICICI Prudential.

Markets.title: Lululemon’s turnaround gets tougher as new CEO inherits a battered brand; shares fall 20%
Markets.summary: Lululemon shares fell 20% after the sportswear maker lowered its full-year sales forecast due to declining sales in its signature leggings business and rising competition from Alo and Vuori. New CEO Heidi O'Neill faces the challenge of regaining customer relevance and sales growth as the brand struggles.

Markets.title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Dow  stocks slip as stronger jobs report lifts rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks fell after an August jobs report that was stronger than expected increased expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. Investors also pushed stocks lower as they awaited upcoming inflation data and watched declines in companies like Lululemon and Adobe.

Markets.title: Sebi approves 3 IPOs of Cosmic PV, Monomark, RKB Global along with NSE
Markets.summary: SEBI has approved initial public offerings for Cosmic PV Power, Monomark Engineering, RKB Global, and the National Stock Exchange. These approvals mark a significant revival in India's IPO market during the second half of 2026.

Geo-Political.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
Geo-Political.summary: Germany has blamed Russia for a recent attack on Leipzig airport amid a broader wave of suspicious incidents across Europe. Authorities strongly suspect Russia is orchestrating this spiralling sabotage campaign targeting the continent.

Geo-Political.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
Geo-Political.summary: Hundreds of workers remain trapped inside a network of tunnels along the Trishuli river in Nepal following devastating floods. Recent rescue operations inside these tunnels have successfully brought out survivors, providing a rare moment of hope.

Geo-Political.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
Geo-Political.summary: Downing Street stated that British support for the Falkland Islands remains unwavering following renewed claims to the territory by Argentinian President Javier Milei. Milei had asserted that shifting political dynamics favor Argentina's sovereignty claim over the British overseas territory.

Geo-Political.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone struck the Ukrainian security headquarters in Kyiv without warning. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the attack.

Geo-Political.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
Geo-Political.summary: Australian television personality and conservationist Steve Irwin died in 2006 after being pierced in the chest by a stingray barb during filming. Twenty years later, his family is celebrating his enduring legacy and remembering him as a superhero.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
Geo-Political.summary: President Donald Trump's peace envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, are visiting Moscow and Kyiv this weekend to restart stalled negotiations. Their mission is to revive efforts to end the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war.

AI & Tech.summary: A marketer discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry options. This visibility was achieved without paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization strategies.

Data & Insights.title: 'Lower interest rates or...,' Trump turns up heat on hand-picked Fed chair Kevin Warsh, threatens trade shutdown
Data & Insights.summary: President Trump pressured Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to lower interest rates and threatened to cut trade with countries having trade deficits. This escalation highlights the administration's aggressive economic strategy regarding monetary policy and international trade.

Data & Insights.title: World's biggest wealth fund plans to cut government bonds, US Treasuries face $75 billion impact
Data & Insights.summary: Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund plans to reduce its government bond holdings from 70% to 50% to diversify risk and increase returns. Pending government approval, this shift is expected to reduce its US Treasury holdings by $75 billion.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves jump $11.5 billion to record high of $740.8 billion
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves rose by $11.5 billion to reach a record high of $740.8 billion. This surpassed the previous peak of $728.494 billion set during the week ending February 27.

Data & Insights.title: E-way bill generation rises 7.7% to over 139 million in August
Data & Insights.summary: E-way bill generation increased by 7.7% to over 139 million in August. This figure has remained above the 130-million mark for the fifth consecutive month this fiscal year.

Data & Insights.title: iBRICS 2026: $1 trillion global sovereign capital in focus as 500 investors gather in Delhi next week
Data & Insights.summary: The Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute is convening the iBRICS 2026 conference in Delhi next week to connect $1 trillion in global sovereign capital with infrastructure, energy, and digital projects. The event will bring together 500 investors across 21 BRICS member states and partner nations to fund bankable initiatives.

Data & Insights.title: GDP data row: What is Base Year, how is it revised and why has it raised a political storm? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: A base-year revision allows the government to incorporate newer data sources and improve its methodology for measuring the economy. This process has sparked a political controversy because updated calculations can significantly change the reported economic outlook.

India.title: FBI-Wanted Fraudster Arrested In Jalandhar Over $600,000 Scam In US
India.summary: Jalandhar police arrested an FBI-wanted fraudster on August 16, 2026, following an investigation into a US-based $600,000 scam. Authorities registered a local case against the suspect to facilitate the ongoing legal proceedings.

India.title: "First Step To Victory": Teen Dalit Activist On Swatantra Bhardwaj's Detention
India.summary: Far-right activist Swatantra Bhardwaj was detained after boasting on a podcast about facing no legal consequences for attacking a Dalit activist's father. The teen Dalit activist called the detention the "first step to victory."

India.title: Omar Abdullah Meets Amit Shah, Discusses Early Restoration Of J&K's Statehood
India.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah met with Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi. The two leaders discussed the early restoration of statehood for Jammu and Kashmir.

India.title: "Cracked His Skull" Was Not All. Far-Right Influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj's Vitriol Spanned Hour-Long Podcast
India.summary: Far-right influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj appeared on a podcast where he expressed hatred toward Muslims and made claims about political patronage. During the hour-long interview, he also stated that someone "cracked his skull."

India.title: Assam Signs MoUs With 6 Firms, IIT Madras To Bring AI To Schools
India.summary: Assam signed Memorandums of Understanding with six firms and IIT Madras to integrate artificial intelligence into schools. Under the agreement, an IIT Madras AI platform will be piloted in 50 schools to assist students with language and mathematics learning.

India.title: How BJP Is Treating Local Elections In Rajasthan As A Diagnostic Test After CJP Jolt
India.summary: The BJP is using the Rajasthan local elections as a test to gauge cadre morale, caste equations, youth sentiment, and the fallout from the Cockroach Janta Party's Jantar Mantar protest. The campaign and its eventual results will provide the party with a diagnostic reading of these political dynamics following the CJP protest.

General.title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
General.summary: Violence has escalated in Middlesbrough following a fatal A66 crash. Local residents report living in fear, with some stating they distrust the police too much to call them.

General.title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
General.summary: Cleveland Police Chief Victoria Fuller expressed pride in her force but stated they are being let down by a lack of funding. She believes the department needs to become part of a larger, strategic force with greater resources.

General.title: Farage threatens to overhaul Lords and judges to meet his pledges
General.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has threatened to overhaul the House of Lords and the judiciary to fulfill his campaign pledges. He promised to deliver these key priorities within the first 100 days if his party wins power.

General.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
General.summary: The United Nations voted to adopt a new world map that reflects Africa's true size. The Togo-sponsored resolution passed with support from 164 nations, with the United States as the sole vote against it.

General.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that a Russian drone strike hit the security headquarters in Kyiv. The unmanned aerial vehicle attacked the heart of the Ukrainian capital without warning.
